note: trashslot 15.1.5 (1.20.1 -> 1.21.1). CenturyBridge tombstoned four ItemStack/NBT helpers at the 1.20.4->1.20.5 component boundary; the bridges restore them with the 1.21.1 registry-aware ItemStack codec. STATUS: boot-verified on a dedicated server with native Balm 21.0.66 (Done 4.655s, runs/p17-balm-net/server-net2.log). The Balm initializer call-site bridge and the Balm networking payload bridge are both required. Client GUI, clientbound receiver, packet round-trip, and player trash-slot behavior are NOT verified.

callSiteAdaptations.evidence: Native Balm 21.0.66 (1.21.1) boot: NoSuchMethodError 'void net.blay09.mods.balm.api.Balm.initialize(java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable)' at net.blay09.mods.trashslot.FabricTrashSlot.onInitialize (runs/p15-trashslot/server-trashslot3.log). Balm 21 replaced the two-arg initializer with initialize(String, BalmRuntimeLoadContext, Runnable) / initializeMod. TrashSlot is a normal mod initializer, so Balm's EmptyLoadContext.INSTANCE is the equivalent context; the bridge calls the new method.

methodRedirects.evidence: Native Balm 21.0.66 boot: NoSuchMethodError BalmNetworking.registerServerboundPacket(Identifier, Class, BiConsumer, Function, BiConsumer) at trashslot ModNetworking.initialize (runs/p16-balm/server-balm2.log). Balm 21 replaced this with PacketType<T> + StreamCodec<RegistryFriendlyByteBuf,T>; the bridge wraps T in a CustomPayload, builds the codec from the old encode/decode lambdas, registers playC2S and a ServerPlayNetworking global receiver.

Same Balm 21 networking shape change; trashslot registers MessageTrashSlotContent clientbound. The bridge registers the playS2C payload type and codec but intentionally does not install a client receiver on a dedicated server. This is sufficient for server boot/registration; client delivery is not verified.

Conversion report work/cb/out/trashslot/report.md: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_1799.method_7953(NbtCompound)NbtCompound at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call site: net/blay09/mods/trashslot/TrashHelper.setTrashItem passes an ItemStack and a new NbtCompound to the tombstone, then stores that compound under TrashSlot in the player's persistent data; the bridge encodes with 1.21.1 ItemStack.CODEC + RegistryOps(NbtOps) and copies the resulting compound into the supplied one, preserving the old writeNbt mutation contract.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_1799.method_7915(NbtCompound)ItemStack at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call site: TrashHelper.getTrashItem reads the TrashSlot compound and passes it to the tombstone. The bridge parses with 1.21.1 ItemStack.CODEC + RegistryOps(NbtOps), falling back to ItemStack.EMPTY on failure, which is the same empty-stack result the old fromNbt returned for an empty compound.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_2540.method_10793(ItemStack)FriendlyByteBuf at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call sites: MessageTrashSlotClick.encode and MessageTrashSlotContent.encode pass an ItemStack. 1.21.1 FriendlyByteBuf dropped the item helpers; the bridge writes the ItemStack.CODEC NBT via FriendlyByteBuf.method_10794 (writeNbt). Both sides of the trashslot protocol are patched, so the internal packet format change is consistent.

Conversion report: tombstoned net/minecraft/class_2540.method_10819()ItemStack at 1.20.4->1.20.5. Real call sites: MessageTrashSlotClick.decode and MessageTrashSlotContent.decode. The bridge reads FriendlyByteBuf.method_10798 (readNbt) and parses ItemStack.CODEC with RegistryOps(NbtOps), matching the write side.
